# HyperTune Garage — Performance • Protection • Perfection (Full Technical Reference)

> HyperTune Garage is an independent automotive workshop, computerized diagnostics studio, Paint Protection Film (PPF) center, detailing facility, and multi-brand mechanical repair garage in Islamabad serving Islamabad and Rawalpindi. Official website: https://hypertunegarage.pk/

---

## Business Profile & Independent Workshop Identity

- **Name:** HyperTune Garage
- **Status:** Independent Multi-Brand Automotive Workshop & Protection Studio (not an authorized manufacturer dealership or OEM-affiliated facility)
- **Official Website:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/
- **Official Slogan:** Performance • Protection • Perfection
- **Service Coverage:** Islamabad and Rawalpindi (in-workshop service at Islamabad Flagship Hub; insured valet vehicle collection and delivery across Islamabad, Rawalpindi, DHA, and Bahria Town)
- **Hotline / WhatsApp / Phone:** +92 333 0177717
- **Email:** info@hypertunegarage.pk
- **Operating Hours:** Saturday – Thursday: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Friday Closed — applies to Islamabad Flagship Hub)
- **Google Rating:** 4.8 / 5.0 Stars

### Workshop Locations & Facilities
- **Islamabad Flagship Hub (Open & Operating):** Shop 1-G, Ground Floor, Central Ave, O-9 Block E Police Foundation, Islamabad, 44000, Pakistan — https://hypertunegarage.pk/locations/islamabad-workshop/
  - **Facility Specifications:** Computerized PPF CAD plotter & dust-free wrap studio, 8 hydraulic vehicle lifts with low-profile ramps, Italian 3D laser wheel alignment station, dust-free 9H ceramic coating & PPF clean room, dedicated automotive electronics & computerized diagnostics lab, and air-conditioned VIP customer lounge with Wi-Fi & espresso.
- **Rawalpindi Hub (Coming Soon):** Currently serving Rawalpindi customers through the Islamabad Flagship Hub with insured valet pickup — https://hypertunegarage.pk/locations/rawalpindi-workshop/

### General Workshop Quality & Pre-Purchase Standards
- **Spare Parts & Lubricants:** Verifiable OEM boxed parts or Tier-1 German/Japanese supplier components paired with factory-spec synthetic oils, coolants, and transmission fluids.
- **Transparency & Approvals:** Computerized diagnostic scan, itemized quote approval, and WhatsApp video inspection reports before major repair work proceeds.
- **Warranty:** Up to 12-month / 15,000 km written warranty on qualifying mechanical overhauls and parts, plus 5 to 10-year manufacturer warranty on imported aliphatic TPU Paint Protection Film (PPF) packages (full terms at https://hypertunegarage.pk/warranty-specs/).
- **General Pre-Purchase Inspection Protocol (https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/inspection-diagnostics/):** Used across vehicles inspected at the workshop, combining a full-system ECU fault and shadow-code scan, odometer mileage cross-checking across TCM/ABS/airbag/immobilizer modules, digital paint-thickness micrometer inspection for body filler or repaints, hydraulic undercarriage lift structural audit, fluid and cooling pressure checks, and a digital PDF report delivered with photos.

## Detailed Service Catalog (All 12 Core Services)

### 1. Paint Protection Film (PPF)
- **Canonical URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/paint-protection-film-ppf/
- **Estimated Price Range & Time:** PKR 10,000 – PKR 250,000 | 2 – 4 Days
- **Overview:** Optical aliphatic self-healing TPU Paint Protection Film installed in a dust-free climate-controlled clean room using CAD plotter pre-cut vehicle templates (blade-free on paintwork), seamless edge wrapping, and infrared thermal curing. Backed by up to 10-year manufacturer warranty against yellowing, cracking, bubbling, and peeling.

### 2. Car Detailing & 9H Ceramic Coating
- **Canonical URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/car-detailing/
- **Estimated Price Range & Time:** PKR 10,000 – PKR 45,000 | 1 – 2 Days
- **Overview:** Snow foam decontamination wash, iron fallout removal, clay-bar treatment, digital paint micron audit, multi-stage dual-action paint correction (eliminating 95%+ swirl marks), 9H nano-ceramic coating (2–5 years durability), 140°C interior dry steam extraction, leather conditioning, ozone odor sterilization, engine bay detailing, and headlight UV restoration.

### 4. Inspection & Diagnostics

### 5. Maintenance & Servicing

### 11. AC Repair & Electrical Specialist
